title: Epistemic Constitutionalism Or: how to avoid coherence bias.

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting identical policy arguments to AI models (Claude Sonnet 4.5 and GPT-4o) using Anthropic's Petri evaluation framework, varying only the attributed source across different German and Swiss political parties, think tanks, and advocacy organizations, and measuring how the models' argument credibility and strength ratings shift based on the source's ideological position.
